Trouve le mot en 6 essais. La première l: Find the word in 6 tries. The first letter is given and the length changes every day (5 to 8 letters). Green square: good letter, well placed · yellow circle: the letter is in the word, elsewhere · gray: it is not there. Accents do not count, and the typed word must exist (all forms: plurals, conjugations). The same word for everyone every day; free part, as many words as you want. At the end, the word's definition is shown (Wiktionary, CC BY-SA). Games, series and statistics saved and synchronized. Words: Glossary 3.83 (CC BY-SA 4.0).
